PART 1: State hygienic practices to observe  The

What this means
In this part you learn to state hygienic practices to observe  The. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state hygienic practices to observe  The.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state hygienic practices to observe  The. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
